sv.title: Better Collective stuvar om i ledningen
sv.summary: Affiliatebolaget Better Colelctives ena grundare Jesper Søgaard tar över som ensam vd. Hans medgrundare och tidigare med-vd Christian Kirk Rasmussen kommer framöver fokusera på bland annat affiliate-projekt.

en.title: Better Collective reshuffles its management
en.summary: Affiliate company Better Collective's co-founder Jesper Søgaard takes over as sole CEO. His co-founder and former co-CEO Christian Kirk Rasmussen will in future focus on, among other things, affiliate projects.
